text:
You're wasting years on the wrong woman.

Because nobody taught you this:

1. Young women want excitement, adventure, and a man who stands out. Settling down is the last thing on her mind.

2. Older women want commitment, loyalty, and a man who can build a life with them.

She didn't change on you. She grew.

Stop being bitter. Start reading the room.

And stop being a one trick man.

Build the fire AND the foundation.

The man who has both doesn't chase. He chooses.
caption:
Discipline in dating means understanding what she actually wants before you show up. That mindset separates men who win from men who wonder why.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
